name: Scoop
text:
Decision: We should refresh the AI-news digest by pulling the latest official releases from the top 5 national AI research labs (NVIDIA, DeepMind, Microsoft Research, IBM Research, and Meta AI) and the EU’s AI Office, plus the newest company blogs from the FAANG+ group (Apple, Amazon, Google, Meta, Microsoft, Tesla).

Reason: These sources move fastest and set the tone for the rest of the industry. Missing even one could leave us behind on a breaking policy or product drop. The trade-off is speed vs. noise—we’ll have to filter duplicates and low-signal posts, but that’s cheaper than missing a real shift.
